long_biography.plain_text:
At the Ahinoam Association, businessman Refael “Rafi” Edry has focused his public work on long-term social mobility. The charity follows young people from age 14 through higher education and employment, using individual plans instead of one-off assistance.

Its programmes concentrate on communities at Israel's geographic and social periphery. They provide scholarships for first-generation students, guide young people into suitable work and offer tailored mentoring for teenagers outside established welfare services. Edry grew up in Safed, giving him direct experience of life outside Israel's economic centre. The organisation continues its support until participants enter working life.
